rubric: Each citation occurrence: preceding sentence/paragraph/table cell. Fully supported only if all factual details in that unit appear in or follow directly from cited evidence. Plausible external examples/inferences without a separate knowledge label count as not fully supported. Uncited claims are excluded from this denominator and separately noted. Corpus-absence statement checked against the full synthetic corpus. This is a diagnostic unit-level metric, not exhaustive atomic-claim annotation.
